items.item: `Sources/POSIX Kernel File/POSIX.Kernel.File.Flush+Directory.swift`: every path error from openin
items.reason: File is now POSIX.Kernel.File.Flush.swift. Each Path.Resolution.Error (notDirectory, loop, nameTooLong, ...) is now thrown as .platform with its own errno rather than always ENOENT. Permission errors (EACCES) were never path errors and already passed through as .platform. A dedicated .path case would need a new case on ISO_9945.Kernel.File.Flush.Error in swift-iso/swift-iso-9945 (not in my set); the errno-preserving mapping keeps the real cause with no API change.

notes: New tests: Tests/POSIX Kernel Tests/POSIX.Kernel.File.Flush Tests.swift (ENOTDIR below a regular file; ENOENT for a missing path). If the owner wants the path error as its own case, add `case path(Path.Resolution.Error)` to ISO_9945.Kernel.File.Flush.Error (+ code/description) and pass it through here.
